name: component_recombination_generate_pilot_10_baseline_passed
description: Two browser-verified component-rich Vue seeds per ComUIBench capability profile. Each produces one new full-site Generate target by adding a useful route composed from existing component units.

seeds.target_hint: Add a collector decision page that recomposes ArtifactCard, MarkBadge, ArtifactModal, and shared navigation into a condition-and-provenance triage workspace.
Add a repair readiness page that combines ContentCard, StepIndicator, FormInput, and BaseButton into a diagnostic preparation flow using the existing shell.
Add a field campaign planner that composes ProjectCard, PersonCard, EquipmentItem, and DatasetCard into one cross-resource planning view.
Add a learner pathway page that combines CourseCard, MentorCard, ProjectShowcase, and TestimonialItem into a coherent personalized journey.
Add a booth readiness review page that recomposes existing input, checkbox, radio, info-card, status-badge, and toast components around local application state.
Add an event loadout builder that combines EquipmentCard, BaseSelect, BaseInput, StatusBadge, and NotificationToast with reservation data.
Add a communal meal planner by recomposing FilterableGallery, MediaCard, PricingTable, ExpandableSection, and StickyActionBar within the established design system.
Add a civic briefing page that composes NewsCard, EventCard, FactCheckBadge, PullQuote, and AccordionItem into an evidence-led reading workflow.
Add a mentorship learning-plan page that combines ProfileSummary, FilterBar, ListItem, AccordionItem, and Stepper for a selected student-mentor pairing.
Add a museum visit itinerary that recomposes ArtifactVisual, ContentCard, TimelineEvent, FloorMap, and WayfindingBadge across gallery, schedule, and visitor contexts.
